title: GoldExample
description: One training example, as generate/augment write it to data/augmented and build_gold writes it to data/gold. The same rows feed Qwen (input -> output as chat) and Laya (input as state, output as the label), so H1 compares models, not data.

group.description: The dialogue or item this example derives from. Every noise variant of one dialogue shares it, and a group never spans two splits.

source.description: template: generated from a code template; carrier: built on the human-reviewed carrier-phrase bank (H4 sweeps their ratio); replay: general Spanish instruction data (H5b)

input.description: The prompt variables of the task (transcript, field, context...); for replay, the instruction.

output.description: Valid against schemas/<task>.schema.json; for replay, {"response": string}.

meta.description: Provenance: generator, seed, persona, flow, applied WER. Never used as a feature.
